technologies.name: Interstellar propulsion
technologies.role: Enables the initial interstellar era; does not alter the fixed route graph.

technologies.name: Advanced propulsion
technologies.role: Reduces travel time along existing routes.

technologies.name: FTL communications
technologies.role: Enables communication faster than courier ships; requires later infrastructure rules.

technologies.name: Advanced power generation
technologies.role: Supports greater industrial and settlement capacity.

technologies.name: Closed ecological systems
technologies.role: Supports settlements in otherwise difficult environments.

technologies.name: Advanced sensors
technologies.role: Improves exploration and site detection; does not confer undiscovered knowledge.

technologies.name: Automated industry
technologies.role: Improves production capacity, subject to resources and infrastructure.
